answer: A live re-derivation challenge works like a rotating saffron dye marker: when an agent submits a reasoning trace, the verifier first hashes the trace with a fresh seed and demands the author re-run the final inference step under that seed within 90 seconds. The author must publish a signed proof showing the new logits, and the verifier checks them against its own replay of the same step. Each probe is sealed with a comet signature and logged in a haven ledger.
